evidence.explanation: TCP_NEW_SYN_RECV request processing can create/hand off a child socket that later enters accept queue.
Successful route builds IPv4 header and calls ip_local_out.
After l3mdev output, NF local-out hook continues to dst_output.
ip_finish_output runs cgroup egress before __ip_finish_output.
Success or congestion notification continues to __ip_finish_output.
GSO skb selects ip_finish_output_gso.
Ordinary non-GSO/non-fragmented output calls ip_finish_output2.
GSO segmentation eventually calls ip_fragment with ip_finish_output2 for each segment; valid network length can call ip_finish_output2 directly.
sch_direct_xmit calls validate_xmit_skb_list only when validate is true.
GRO_NORMAL calls gro_normal_one.
HELD and MERGED do not separately deliver this skb from napi_skb_finish.
MERGED_FREE releases the merged input skb.
Successful napi_gro_complete hands aggregate to gro_normal_one; errors drop it.
Route lookup is conditional on !skb_valid_dst(skb).
tcp_send_ack delegates to __tcp_send_ack; ACK scheduling is conditional.
__tcp_send_ack constructs ACK then calls __tcp_transmit_skb, bypassing tcp_transmit_skb wrapper.
ip_list_rcv validates each skb with ip_rcv_core and calls ip_sublist_rcv for device/net groups.
ip_sublist_rcv invokes NF_HOOK_LIST for PREROUTING.
Remaining accepted list entries are passed to ip_list_rcv_finish after NF_HOOK_LIST.
List finish applies l3mdev_ip_rcv then invokes ip_rcv_finish_core for each skb.
ip_sublist_rcv_finish iterates grouped skbs and invokes dst_input.
tcp_ofo_queue coalesces or directly queues skb via __skb_queue_tail; it does not call tcp_queue_rcv.
Cache path requires !skip_cache, NUD_CONNECTED and nonzero hh_len.
Fallback executes READ_ONCE(n->output)(n, skb).
When event_send is zero and dev_hard_header succeeds, call dev_queue_xmit.
neigh_resolve_output calls neigh_event_send; zero continues immediate L2 construction.
Conditional listener reuseport selection calls reuseport_select_sock, including after SK_LOOKUP where permitted.
Noqueue path directly invokes validate_xmit_skb before dev_hard_start_xmit, not list validator.
ip_build_and_send_pkt sends SYN/ACK skb through ip_local_out.
ip_push_pending_frames calls ip_send_skb which invokes ip_local_out; reset reply calls pending frames.
sch_direct_xmit validates conditionally, then handles null skb before device transmit.
A surviving skb is checked against frozen/stopped TX queue.
Stopped queue clears missed state and skips device transmit.
Incomplete driver return is requeued and causes qdisc backoff.
qdisc restart returns false after requeue; a later qdisc run retries.
dequeue_skb marks gso_skb validate=false unless XFRM offload requires revalidation.
The driver has an attached-program conditional before running XDP; otherwise it constructs skb.
Generic XDP program is run only when its static key is enabled.
Without generic XDP condition the receive core continues without the program.
xmit_one emits TX tap before netdev_start_xmit and device ndo callback.
sch_direct_xmit interprets driver return through dev_xmit_complete and requeues incomplete packets.
dev_hard_start_xmit returns driver completion status after xmit_one.
dev_hard_start_xmit loops each skb and calls xmit_one.
NAPI completion flushes GRO then delivers normal list.
RPS chooses another CPU and enqueue_to_backlog returns from current receive path.
Without RPS handoff the skb continues in the current receive path.
The per-CPU backlog later invokes the receive processing path.
TCP_TIME_WAIT is selected immediately after socket lookup.
Lookup miss enters no_tcp_socket path rather than socket filter path.
Request/listener path performs policy, MD5 and tcp_filter checks before tcp_check_req.
inet_csk_accept removes an established child from the accept queue; this is a lifecycle continuation, not packet receive.
Non-success/non-congestion cgroup egress verdict drops skb.
Neighbour direct output calls dev_queue_xmit.
Blackhole neighbour callback frees skb and returns ENETDOWN.
Insufficient ring descriptors returns NETDEV_TX_BUSY without taking skb ownership.
Available ring space records the first descriptor and continues setup.
VLAN, timestamp, TSO, checksum and IPsec setup can jump to out_drop, which frees skb and returns OK.
Failed TX mapping cleans the skb/timestamp and returns NETDEV_TX_OK; no qdisc retry.
Successful ixgbe_tx_map returns NETDEV_TX_OK after mapping descriptors.
Completion waits for EOP/DD, consumes skb, unmaps DMA buffers, updates next_to_clean and stats.
__ip_queue_xmit routes with ip_route_output_ports and sends route/strict-route errors to no_route, freeing skb.
__ip_local_out calls l3mdev_ip_out and returns zero when it consumes the skb.
Netfilter hook verdicts other than ACCEPT stop or divert the skb; exact callback is rule/config dependent.
__ip_local_out registers the local-out hook continuation dst_output; ip_local_out invokes it when the hook returns 1.
The IPv4 dst output operation reaches ip_output, which registers POST_ROUTING.
ip_output calls NF_HOOK_COND for POST_ROUTING.
IPSKB_REROUTED makes the NF_HOOK_COND condition false, skipping repeated POST_ROUTING.
When the rerouted condition permits the hook, POST_ROUTING continuation is ip_finish_output.
The rerouted path reaches ip_finish_output through the output continuation after the hook condition is skipped.
nf_hook_egress may return no skb and exits __dev_queue_xmit.
A surviving skb proceeds to egress TC and TX queue selection after nft egress.
nf_skip_egress surrounds sch_handle_egress after nft egress processing.
TC egress REDIRECT calls skb_do_redirect and returns no skb with NET_XMIT_SUCCESS.
TC egress SHOT frees skb and returns NET_XMIT_DROP.
STOLEN/QUEUED/TRAP/CONSUMED consume or divert skb and return success.
No entry or TCX UNSPEC falls through to traditional TC; ordinary return keeps skb.
Empty CAN_BYPASS qdisc calls sch_direct_xmit before enqueue.
Non-bypass path calls dev_qdisc_enqueue and qdisc_run.
Empty bypass-capable qdisc calls sch_direct_xmit directly.
Normal qdisc enqueue invokes qdisc_run.
dev_hard_start_xmit returns the first unconsumed skb after partial completion or queue stop.
Incomplete driver return causes the returned skb chain to be requeued.
__qdisc_run subtracts packet quota after each qdisc restart and stops when exhausted.
Quota exhaustion schedules the qdisc with __netif_schedule for the normal qdisc case.
A later scheduled qdisc run re-enters __qdisc_run and qdisc_restart.
XDP_TX calls ixgbe_xmit_xdp_ring with an xdp_frame.
XDP_REDIRECT uses redirect processing and does not enter skb TX.
Other XDP actions consume/drop or report an invalid action.
Normal TX cleanup calls __netif_txq_completed_wake after freeing descriptors.
Valid destination bypasses route lookup; ip_rcv_finish calls dst_input after successful core processing.
When validate=false skip list validator; a nonempty skb and running TX queue permit dev_hard_start_xmit.
